## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the duplicate adoption message before merge: once adoption records are part of the plan, the command prints each adopted setting twice.

## Changes
`plan` now adds an `adopt` record for each setting that already exists and appends an `audit` record with the number of incoming settings. Two tests were added that check the audit record is returned and is not printed by `run`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop printing adopted settings twice in `run` — If you call `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)`, it prints `"Adopted theme"` twice. `plan` prints it as progress at `app/planner.py:8`, then `app/cli.py:6-9` prints every record that isn't an audit record, and that now includes the new `adopt` record. No test calls `run` with a setting that already exists. — Every adopted setting appears twice in the command output, which contradicts the PR body's description of the command output. — Fix: Either skip `adopt` records in `app/cli.py:7` the same way audit records are skipped, or stop printing progress from `plan`, then add a `run` adoption case next to `test_command_adds_setting`.
